selector.definition: proposal QC-SnapKV: last min32 suffix Q, full causal history denominator, head/position mean, avg_pool7, protected first4/last32, stable lower-position ties
selector.limitation: Selector gathers temporary full K per layer/request and is not optimized; its complete cost must be charged.
